description: The shared Renovate settings of mark1russell7, with no automerge. Extend renovate/default for the automerge rules too.

packageRules.description: One weekly PR for the patch updates of npm packages.
One weekly PR for the minor updates of the runtime dependencies. A person reviews it.
One weekly PR for the minor updates of the development dependencies.
Before 1.0.0, a minor update can break (SemVer). These updates get a PR of their own, and a person reviews it.
A peer dependency range is a promise to the users. Change it by hand.
The release train updates the npm packages of mark1russell7 (@mark1russell7 and @procedures), with no wait. Renovate updates only the third-party npm packages.
One weekly PR for the minor, patch and digest updates of the GitHub Actions.

The shared workflows and actions of the template follow main (@<commit> # main): one weekly PR for all the pins of a repository. The manager github-actions reads '# main' as a branch (Renovate 43.84.0 or later). A commit of main has no release date, so the pin moves with no wait. The schedule stays the quiet Monday window also when a repository changes its own schedule: a workflow change during a release makes the tag job fail (HTTP 403, RELEASING.md).
A major update of a GitHub Action gets a PR of its own, and a person reviews it.

The Claude Code CLI of a workflow (CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION, reusable-ai-review.yml): a PR of its own. It changes the program that runs with the API key, so a person reviews it, and Renovate never merges it (renovate/automerge).
The release session owns the release workflow and its scripts. They change only from ~/git/template (RELEASING.md).

customManagers.description: The version of the Claude Code CLI that a workflow installs from npm: 'CLAUDE_CODE_VERSION: <x.y.z>' (reusable-ai-review.yml).
